title: From the shop — The silk edit

lines.text: Kristina's Cloud scrunchie comes in ivory, sage, deep berry and powder blush.
Each one holds a full metre of mulberry silk.
Prefer a print? Azure Heritage comes in blue paisley or navy polka dots.
And the silk sleep mask comes in the same four colours.
Tell me your colour in the comments.
